title: Areas of Expertise
subtitle: My scope of impact and technical competencies as a Senior Engineer & Tech Lead — from software architecture to production deployment.

items.title: Tech Lead & Fullstack Development
items.text: Design, architecture, and development of high-performance web & mobile apps: Next.js 15, React, Angular, FastAPI, Laravel, Flutter, REST API & OAuth2.

items.title: DevSecOps & Cloud
items.text: Industrialization & cloud deployment: GitLab CI/CD, Docker, Ansible, Terraform, Kubernetes, observability (Grafana, Loki, ELK) and application security (Snyk, SAST).

items.title: AI & RAG Applications
items.text: Development of AI-augmented assistants and chatbots: LangChain, LiteLLM, OpenAI, Ollama / Qwen, vector databases (Qdrant, pgvector) & RAG pipelines.

items.title: AI-Augmented & Agentic Development
items.text: Accelerating the SDLC lifecycle via agentic dev (Claude 3.7 / Claude Code, Antigravity) and Spec-Driven Development (GitHub SpecKit): from spec to production.

items.title: IoT & Real-Time Pipelines
items.text: Real-time streaming data pipelines (Redpanda / Apache Kafka), connected sensor integration (EmotiBit, Withings) and healthcare standards (FHIR / HL7).

items.title: Architecture, Audit & Tech Lead
items.text: Architecture modeling (UML, Merise), performance & security audits, tech stack selection, Tech Lead role and deep code reviews.

items.title: Training & Technical Documentation
items.text: Upskilling teams (Web, DevSecOps, AI), technical documentation (MkDocs), API specifications (OpenAPI / Swagger, Postman), and architecture guidebooks.
